title: Cobblemon: Perfect Partners
description: A companion-focused Cobblemon addon that adds headpats, walking friendship, gifts, memories, Contest Conditions, Shiny Leaves, ribbons, auras, follow assist, and in-game configuration for deeper Pokémon bonding.
body:
# Cobblemon: Perfect Partners 2.0

Perfect Partners is all about making your Pokémon feel a little more like companions. Pet them, travel together, build friendship, earn ribbons, collect Shiny Leaves, and give your favorite partners a bit more personality.

This version brings the main parts of the mod together in a cleaner way, with more ways to bond, train, customize, and show off your Pokémon.

---

## Partner Bonding

Spend time with your Pokémon and build friendship through simple everyday interactions.

* Pet your Pokémon.
* Travel with your Pokémon.
* Spend time near your Pokémon.
* Build friendship over time.
* Get heart particles and feedback during happy interactions.
* Use the dedicated **Pet Interaction** keybind.
* Petting builds friendship and the **Cute** Contest condition.
* Petting supports first-person and third-person animations.

---

## Contest Conditions

Train Contest-style stats by doing different things with your Pokémon.

* **Cool** — battle wins.
* **Beauty** — item use.
* **Cute** — petting.
* **Smart** — using useful blocks and workstations.
* **Tough** — travelling with your Pokémon.

You can view each condition separately, track progress, and unlock cosmetic rewards through Contest training.

---

## Ribbons, Marks, and Titles

Give your Pokémon special accomplishments and a little extra style.

* Pokémon can earn special ribbons.
* Custom titles are supported.
* Titles can be used as prefixes or suffixes.
* Custom titles let you personalize favorite Pokémon.

---

## Auras and Visual Flair

Bonded Pokémon can unlock extra visual effects.

* Unlock aura effects.
* Select auras through commands.
* Show visual effects around bonded Pokémon.
* Adjust particle intensity through config.

---

## Shiny Leaves

Shiny Leaves are a small collection goal for favorite Pokémon.

* Pokémon can discover Shiny Leaves while travelling.
* Each Pokémon can collect five leaves:

  * Leaf A
  * Leaf B
  * Leaf C
  * Leaf D
  * Leaf E
* Leaf locations depend on the Pokémon’s nature.
* Different nature groups search in different biome types.
* Collect all five leaves to earn a Leaf Crown.

---

## Partner Gifts

Pokémon can bring back gifts while travelling with you.

* Gift chances can depend on friendship.
* Gifts can be accepted by interacting with the Pokémon.
* Gift pools can be customized.
* Servers can adjust how often gifts appear.
* Server configs can control gift chances, requirements, and pickup behavior.

---

## Trainer Cards and Certificates

Show off your partner’s progress with simple visual records.

* View partner details.
* Display friendship progress.
* Show Contest condition progress.
* Show Shiny Leaf progress.
* View Leaf Crown certificates.
* View partner certificates.
* Celebrate completed or well-loved Pokémon.

---

## Partner Journal

The Partner Journal is the in-game guide for Perfect Partners.

* Players receive a journal when joining a world.
* Use it to open the guide.
* Sneak-use it to open the partner tracker.
* Craft replacement journals if needed.

The journal covers friendship, petting, gifts, Contest stats, ribbons, Shiny Leaves, certificates, and commands.

---

## Contest Music and MIDI Songs

Add your own music for contests using MIDI files.

* Add `.mid` or `.midi` files to the MIDI folder.
* Use MIDI files for contest songs.
* Open the MIDI folder from the in-game song editor.
* Manage custom songs through the contest song interface.

---

## Friendship Bracelet

The Friendship Bracelet gives players another way to support partner growth.

* Bracelet effects can help with bonding.
* Bracelet behavior can be configured.
* Visual effects can be turned on or off.
* Servers can adjust bracelet balance.

---

## Commands

Perfect Partners includes commands for guides, tracking, contests, cards, certificates, and server tools.

### Player Commands

* `/companionbonds guide`
* `/companionbonds commandguide`
* `/companionbonds memories`
* `/contest`
* `/contest <slot>`
* `/contest show <slot>`
* `/contest shout <slot>`
* `/contest aura <slot> <aura>`
* `/contest messages <slot>`
* `/contest marks <slot>`
* `/contest party`
* `/contest guide`
* `/trainercard`
* `/leafcertificate`
* `/partnercertificate`

### Admin and Config Commands

* `/companionbonds stats`
* `/companionbonds debug_gift`
* `/contest admin ...`
* `/companionbonds config`
* `/companionbonds reload`

---

## Config Menu

Server owners can tune the mod to fit their world.

Config options cover:

* Friendship gain
* Petting behavior
* Follow distance
* Gift chances
* Contest gain rates
* Shiny Leaf discovery
* Particle effects
* Bracelet behavior
* Memory messages
* Visual settings

---

## Animation and Visual Support

Perfect Partners includes simple player animation support for petting and bonding.

* First-person petting animations.
* Third-person petting animations.
* Player arm pose support.
* Outer layer support for sleeves and jacket layers.
* Heart particles during petting.
* Optional visual feedback during partner interactions.

---

## Loader Support

Perfect Partners 2.0 supports:

* Fabric
* NeoForge

For Minecraft 1.21.1.
